title: Seoul: The Karaoke Confession
old_caption:
Taurus planned to confess through a song. The song came out as "I like yogurt."
Turns out saying it plainly works better. Have you ever panic-sung a feeling?

title: Minneapolis: never going outside
old_caption: Virgo found a way to cross a whole city without touching snow, and somehow also without meeting a single person. Which sign in your life packs the backup map?

title: Montreal: the underground crush
old_caption: Cancer heard 'underground city' and moved in emotionally. It took one Bonjour-hi to bring them back up. Who's the friend you have to coax out of the tunnel?

title: Boston: the parking-spot chair
old_caption: Aries thinks a lawn chair can reserve anything, including a skate date with someone they haven't met. Spoiler: you just ask. What's the pettiest thing you've ever saved a spot for?

title: Denver: love at the summit
old_caption: Sagittarius went looking for love on a mountaintop while the cozy one was waiting in town with cocoa. Tag the friend who always needs a summit.

title: Philadelphia: mixed signals, twisted
old_caption: Gemini's texts come with more twists than a soft pretzel. The fix was a plain sentence and a day of the week. Which sign texts in riddles?

title: Pittsburgh: which bridge?
old_caption: Libra can't pick a bridge in the city of bridges. The trick: take the one with someone kind (and a pierogi) on the other side. Which sign needs the longest to decide?

title: Anchorage: the long-night stare
old_caption: Scorpio treats the long winter nights like a staring contest, and the moose is winning. Turns out being seen beats being mysterious. Who's the most intense sign in your group?

title: Vancouver: the snow globe that rains
old_caption: Taurus shook the snow globe and got rain, which feels very on brand for this city. Half an umbrella later, soup counts as a date. Who's your rainy-day sign?

title: Milwaukee: the frozen photo shoot
old_caption: Leo posed on the frozen lake so long the smile froze in place. The one worth meeting asked what Leo actually likes. Which sign has a good side they defend?
